title: Design Engineer
description:
About AMINI AMINI advises, designs, and delivers across strategy, infrastructure, and AI. We work directly with clients on technology decisions, architecture, projects, and AI implementations - and we ship our own products alongside client work (andock.app, mrkr.app, it-provider.ch, and others).
 We’re an ambitious team based in Zug and Zurich - this is your chance to build something remarkable together with a leading edge team.
 The Role We’re looking for an AI-Native Design Engineer who treats interfaces as a craft - the place where business intent, technical constraints, and usability meet.
 You’ll own the design and frontend implementation of experiences across our own products and selected client projects. This is not a pure design role and not a pure engineering role. It’s for someone who moves fluidly between both and ships things that feel considered, polished, and inevitable. Design taste is obviously a must in this role.
 You’ll work closely with architects, solution engineers, and client teams. You’ll have real ownership and a direct path from idea to production.
 What You’ll Do Design and build production interfaces for our products and client solutions (AI tools, agent interfaces, dashboards, internal systems, analytics products, etc.).
 Own the full loop: understand the problem, explore concepts, prototype, implement in code, ship, and iterate.
 Contribute to and evolve design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns that raise the quality bar across everything we build.
 Bring strong visual and interaction craft: motion, depth, clarity, and restraint - while orchestrating AI agents in writing frontend code.
 Collaborate directly with the team and clients. Present work, gather feedback, and make decisions.
 Help shape product direction on our own ventures, not just execute specs.
 What We’re Looking For A strong portfolio of shipped work that demonstrates both design taste and engineering ability.

title: Senior RWE Program Manager - Data/IA Expert
description:
Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace , Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous croyons en des solutions innovantes et en un environnement inclusif où collaboration et développement professionnel vont de pair.
 Dans le cadre de programmes cliniques et data à fort enjeu, nous recherchons un(e) Data & Clinical Program Lead capable de faire le lien entre les équipes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques afin d'accélérer l'exploitation des données tout au long du cycle de développement clinique.
 Vous piloterez des initiatives transverses mêlant Data Science, IA, Data Engineering et Real-World Data, tout en garantissant l'alignement entre les priorités du portefeuille projets et les besoins métier.
 Missions : Program Leadership & Delivery Piloter des programmes data complexes en support du développement clinique. Définir les feuilles de route, jalons et livrables en cohérence avec les priorités stratégiques. Assurer le suivi des risques, dépendances et échéances sur plusieurs projets simultanément. Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance ainsi que le reporting auprès des parties prenantes senior. Favoriser la collaboration entre des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales. Clinical & Data Integration Faire le lien entre les équipes cliniques, scientifiques, Data Science et Data Engineering. Traduire les besoins métiers et les problématiques scientifiques en solutions analytiques concrètes. Accompagner l'intégration des données cliniques, RWD et autres sources de données dans les processus de recherche et développement. Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la valorisation des données utilisées. AI, Analytics & Innovation Contribuer au déploiement de solutions d'intelligence artificielle et d'analytique avancée. Promouvoir l'utilisation des approches data-driven dans la prise de décision clinique. Participer à l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'exploitation des données et de l'IA. title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

 An Overview of this role
 As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team, you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. title: Strategy Director - Creative Strategy, Financial Services
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.
 As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.
 Role: Strategy Director – Creative Strategy, Financial
 Location: London
 About the role:
 As a Strategy Director at OLIVER, you will be the hands-on strategic engine of our dedicated team for a major FS retail bank, working across at least five of its biggest UK brands. Sitting within the OLIVER team, you will take often-complex client briefs from the bank's brand and communications planning team and turn them into sharp creative briefs, strong audience and cultural insight, and clear creative springboards that unlock brilliant work.
 This is not a role that stops at the brief. You will stay close to the creative process from first thought to final execution – feeding back at every stage, holding the bar high, and being confident enough to say when work isn't strong enough yet and how to make it so.
 AI is part of how you think and work, not just a productivity tool. You will use it beyond process and research to uncover sharper insight, find new perspectives and give creative teams better starting points, collaborating with the Head of Planning and CSO to bring the best of Brandtech Group's AI-enabled solutions to the account.
 What you will be doing:

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Grocery & Retail, UK and Ireland
description:
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About the role
 Deliveroo is seeking a commercially driven, strategic and execution-focused Head of New Verticals Marketing to lead the next phase of growth across our grocery and retail businesses in the UK & Ireland. On-demand grocery and retail are among the most exciting parts of our business: customers increasingly want their weekly shop, everyday essentials and gifts delivered quickly, and we help the top grocers and retailers grow to meet these needs.
 You will shape and deliver the UK & Ireland marketing strategy across grocery and retail, managing the marketing budget and driving category positioning, partner growth and campaign excellence, and lead a team to bring it to life. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Commercial, Growth, Product and Analytics, you will act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and some of the biggest brands in the UK & Ireland, driving measurable commercial impact.
 This is a chance to make your mark with real influence over strategy, partners and investment.
 What you'll be doing
 Strategy, planning and performance
 Shape and lead the grocery and retail marketing strategy for the UK & Ireland, tied to ambitious growth targets and informed by what customers, categories and performance are telling us.
 Build annual and quarterly plans around the missions and moments that matter to UK & Ireland shoppers, from the weekly shop to key seasonal and trading events.
 Balance brand building and performance marketing to drive sustainable acquisition, retention and frequency, with disciplined, ROI-led investment.
